name: colab-gpu-status
description: Native VS Code status bar extension for Google Colab: live GPU/VRAM metrics, Compute Units balance, and one-click GPU/TPU/CPU runtime provisioning and stop controls.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run build

commands.title: Colab Status: Open Active Session in Browser
Colab Status: Sign In with Google

enumDescriptions: Use stored Google OAuth session if signed in, otherwise fall back to gcloud Application Default Credentials (ADC).
Use native Google OAuth 2.0 flow stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
Use Google Application Default Credentials (gcloud auth application-default login).
colabStatus.authMode.description: Authentication strategy for Google Colab API requests.

colabStatus.oauthClientId.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Desktop Client ID (used for Sign In with Google when oauthConfigPath is not set).

colabStatus.oauthClientSecret.description: Optional Google OAuth 2.0 Desktop Client Secret (required by Google Cloud Desktop OAuth clients).

colabStatus.oauthConfigPath.description: Optional path to a Google OAuth 2.0 client JSON file (e.g. ~/.colab-cli-oauth-config.json or downloaded Desktop client JSON).

colabStatus.oauthScopes.description: OAuth 2.0 scopes requested during Google Sign In.

colabStatus.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Polling interval in seconds for checking Colab sessions, VRAM, and Compute Units.

colabStatus.queryVram.description: Query live GPU VRAM usage via nvidia-smi over the Colab Jupyter runtime proxy.

colabStatus.showComputeUnits.description: Fetch and display Colab Compute Units (CU) balance and hourly burn rate in the tooltip.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Google Colab GPU Status
walkthroughs.description: Monitor live Google Colab GPU VRAM, track Compute Units, and launch or stop runtimes directly from your status bar.

steps.title: Connect your Google Colab account
steps.description:
Sign in with Google OAuth (tokens are stored securely in VS Code SecretStorage) or automatically reuse existing `gcloud` Application Default Credentials.
[Sign In with Google](command:colabStatus.signIn)

steps.title: Start or monitor a GPU / TPU / CPU runtime
steps.description:
Click the status bar item or hover over it to launch T4, L4, A100, H100, G4, TPU v5e-1/v6e-1, or CPU runtimes (including High-RAM), open the active VM in your browser, or stop idle runtimes.
[Start a Colab Runtime](command:colabStatus.provision)

steps.title: Customize polling, VRAM, and Compute Units
steps.description:
Adjust the status polling interval, toggle live `nvidia-smi` VRAM monitoring, or toggle Compute Units balance display in Settings.
[Open Extension Settings](command:colabStatus.openSettings)
